title: Mekwei language - Wikipedia
text: Mekwei (Menggwei), or Mooi, is a Papuan language of Jayapura Regency, Papua, Indonesia. It is spoken in Kendate, Maribu, Sabron Dosay, and Waibrong villages.

title: Mekwei language — Grokipedia
text: Mekwei (ISO 639-3: msf), also known as Menggwei or Mooi, is a moribund Papuan language spoken by approximately 1,200 people (1987) in the villages of Kendate, Maribu, Sabron Dosay, and Waibrong within Jayapura Regency, Papua Province, Indonesia.
